owner_decisions.pseudo_ground_truth: Use identical DE+FR predictions at confidence >= 0.90 as CH training pseudo-ground truth, explicitly marked non-human and non-holdout.
owner_decisions.artwork_scope: Full CH artwork scope except 4.88 and 4.90, which are left out because no cleared artwork source is available in the current scope.
owner_decisions.target_device_constraints: Unchanged from the existing Android and iPhone model targets.

mapping_source.location: external workspace input supplied to the audit

notes: Archive presence proves source availability only; it does not grant reproduction rights.
ASTRA downloads often contain legacy EPS/WMF alongside a smaller number of SVG files.
The current ASTRA archive does not include 4.88 or 4.90 even though both remain official sign references; they need separately cleared artwork.

public_catalog_sample.note: This is a metadata-only availability sample; it is not a training inventory and does not prove Swiss geographic completeness.

panoramax_inventory.note: Use existing country archives as detector/classifier bootstrap only; collect a Swiss, route-grouped corpus before claiming CH recognition.

expansion_detector.tail_repair: one malformed trailing JSONL record excluded; original retained as candidates-lowconf.jsonl.before-tail-repair

research_crawl.license_policy: Only public CC-BY-SA-4.0 features and HTTPS derivatives; no Panoramax writes; CH labels require review or the recorded dual-classifier pseudo-label policy.

dual_classifier_pseudo_labels.policy: DE and FR top-1 predictions are normalized through the reviewed country mapping; accept only identical CH code and both confidences >= 0.90.

expansion_dual_classifier_pseudo_labels.policy: DE and FR top-1 predictions are normalized through the reviewed country mapping; accept only identical CH code and both confidences >= 0.90.

cumulative_expansion_dual_classifier_pse.policy: DE and FR top-1 predictions are normalized through the reviewed country mapping; accept only identical CH code and both confidences >= 0.90.

evaluation_pack.artwork_render_policy: 116 ASTRA source-preparation renders; synthetic coverage only, not Swiss field imagery or human ground truth

real_validation.label_basis: DE+FR agreement pseudo-labels; no human-level ground truth

model_readiness.target_pipeline: YOLOX-Nano-derived proposal detector + MobileNetV3-Large crop classifier + temporal passage reducer
